comment: Manifest for e2e/src/otlp_naming.rs (issue #461). One entry per series the shared OTLP payload must produce on BOTH backends, so adding a metric to the payload forces this file to move with it. `{R}` is the per-run isolation id; `{SVC}` is the per-run service name (varied because target_info is resource-level and carries no data-point run id, so two runs sharing a resource collide as `400 out of order sample` on the reference).

rate_query.comment: The query the Grafana panel on issue #461 sent, verbatim, with a run_id matcher added so the assertion is scoped. The answer is Prometheus's rate extrapolation on a counter advancing exactly 1/s — NOT `1`, which is why it has to be captured from the reference rather than reasoned out.
